story.title: Ava Marie Saint’s cause of death confirmed
story.summary: Ava Marie Saint, the Oscar-winning actress, passed away on October 6 at the age of 102. She died from cardiopulmonary arrest, with contributing factors including senile dementia and hypertension. Saint was known for her roles in classics like 'On the Waterfront' and 'North by Northwest.' She is survived by two children, four grandchildren, and two great-grandchildren.
